body: Use the side gate for vehicle collection.

Staffed Merivanto Transfer Espoo received the passenger car and keys at 20 Oct 20:30 local. Yard arrival photos record its condition; yard custody continues until a separate release to leg two is logged.

First driver completed Oulu to staffed Espoo yard; the 20:30 local arrival and condition photos establish yard custody overnight. Second driver missed the 09:00-11:00 local collection slot. Only the second assignment and offer were withdrawn; the first leg remains complete. A new offer is open without a confirmed driver. Yard release photos are required and not submitted. The new yard slot is tomorrow, after the original customer delivery window. No revised target is approved.

One accepted bundle covers CD-420413 on Monday and CD-420384 on Tuesday. The two legs meet at the same Tampere site, but the driver is not known to remain there overnight. Confirm Tuesday positioning and the second car's overnight custody plan before collection; the Wednesday delivery target is separate from a confirmed handover.

The driver remains assigned after reporting illness. They promised an update by 18:00 local, then said they were still unsure. No cancellation or replacement is recorded. Prepare coverage against the existing slot and check any paid positioning travel before deciding what to change.

The branch has the car and delivery photos were submitted, but the signed handover is still missing. Accounting asked for that specific file. Search the driver and branch handover trail before sending a completion packet; photos do not supply the missing signature.

The Munich branch could not locate the car when the driver arrived, and the customer cancelled. The driver's EUR 12 parking claim is still submitted, not approved. Keep that cost review open even though CD-420201 is cancelled.
Driver's train is due at 26 Oct 08:20 local; Espoo pickup opens at 26 Oct 10:00. Check the station-to-branch transfer before treating the booking as a complete positioning plan.
